description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made under Section 3 of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011
categorisation: This gazette notification contains an order made under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011, which establishes regulatory changes to import levies and exemptions for goods imported from Singapore under the Sri Lanka-Singapore Free Trade Agreement. It modifies legal/regulatory frameworks by specifying new concessionary rates and exemptions, making it a clear example of legal/regulatory content rather than government personnel/structure matters.
